hook.say: The biggest, the longest, the deepest. Five record breakers from Turkey. Can you score five out of five?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is Türkiye's most populous city?
questions.say: Which is Turkey's most populous city?
questions.fact: More than 15 million people live in Istanbul.
questions.sayAnswer: Istanbul! More than 15 million people live there.

questions.q: What world record does the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge hold?
questions.say: What world record does the 1915 Cha-nak-ka-leh Bridge hold?
questions.fact: Its main span is 2,023 m, the longest of any suspension bridge.
questions.sayAnswer: The longest main span! At 2023 meters, it is the longest of any suspension bridge.

questions.fact: Gökçeada, in the Aegean Sea, is also known as Imbros.
questions.sayAnswer: Gok-cheh-ada! This island in the Aegean Sea is also known as Imbros.

questions.q: Marmaray, the rail tunnel under the Bosphorus, holds which record?
questions.say: Marmaray, the rail tunnel under the Bosphorus, holds which record?
questions.fact: It lies up to 60 m below sea level and opened in 2013.
questions.sayAnswer: The deepest immersed tube tunnel! It lies up to 60 meters below sea level, and opened in 2013.

questions.q: Which Turkish province has the longest coastline?
questions.say: Which Turkish province has the longest coastline?
questions.fact: Muğla's twisting coast of bays and peninsulas runs over 1,000 km.
questions.sayAnswer: Moo-la! Its twisting coast of bays and peninsulas runs for more than 1000 kilometres.
